description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5905004603572 RESISTOR,THERMAL: Line 0001 Qty 55 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0067 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Approved sources are 27361 BP18012; 2X920 69B25531-1; 55097 3615-AY1-C. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
